csv.datetime: ISO 8601; server times without invented offset; verified UTC times end with Z

windows_note: These are proposed input lengths, not measured coverage. Never pad missing history with invented bars. Keep actual counts and exclusions.

indicators.ema: EMA of close; alpha=2/(n+1); seed is SMA of first n valid chronological closes. Version changes require regeneration.
indicators.rsi: Wilder RSI(14), seed mean gains/losses of first 14 changes; both averages zero =>50; zero losses and positive gains =>100.
indicators.atr: Wilder ATR(14): TR=max(high-low,abs(high-prev_close),abs(low-prev_close)); initial ATR is mean of first 14 valid TRs.
indicators.warmup: Compute on prior continuous source history, not only exported event window. Prefer full prior history; minimum 1000 completed bars for exported EMA200 features; flags remain invalid when unavailable.

price_action.swing_rule_proposal: 2 closed bars left and 2 closed bars right, strict extrema; ties not pivots. Swing only available after right-side confirmation closes.
price_action.selection: Shape/structure only, no win rate, return, RR, future MFE or outcome filter. Include accepted examples, rejected/unclear review records and matched no-setup controls.
price_action.catalog_status: Draft qualitative definitions; exact numerical detector thresholds and entry/exit parameters are not finalized.

causal_rules: Every input bar close_time_server <= event decision_time_server. Each timeframe may end at a different last-closed boundary.
Only fully closed bars in v1 inputs. Do not use the final OHLC of a historically unfinished M5/M15 candle.
Levels known_at_server <= decision cutoff; for per-bar level features, known_at must also be <= that row close time.
Pattern and side annotations, plan targets and future outcomes are not default input features.
Quote snapshots use last tick <= decision and include age; no fill at a future quote mislabeled as decision-time input.
Missing calendar or timezone mappings stay unavailable. Do not mark missing news as no news.
execution_rules: No live orders. Collect or simulate only.
Market entries occur on the first eligible executable quote after decision plus registered delay. Pending entries follow actual quote crossings.
Buy entry uses Ask and exit uses Bid; sell entry uses Bid and exit uses Ask.
Stop and target are fixed from information known at decision unless an explicit causal trailing rule exists.
Entry expires if unfilled; time stop exits after max_hold_seconds from fill. Missing future observations cause censoring.
If SL and TP are both compatible with a single bar and real ticks cannot resolve order, label ambiguous. Do not automatically assume TP first.
Historical commissions and slippage are not inferred from bars. Record unknowns and explicit simulation scenarios.
Spread/slippage included in executable fill prices are not subtracted again. Net results remain blank if required costs are unknown.

splitting.method: Global chronological train/validation/test across all pairs; final dates chosen after actual coverage is measured.
splitting.purge: No overlap of full input-to-label intervals across different splits. Purge crossing events and add an explicit embargo. overlap_group_id alone is not proof.
splitting.normalization: Fit scaler and thresholds only on training data; preserve raw prices; calculate normalized distances/returns causally.
splitting.controls: Controls are selected without future outcomes. Record population counts and sampling probability before balancing; training-only resampling must not alter validation/test prevalence.

raw_history_policy: Keep a separate immutable per-pair monthly raw M1 archive from earliest actual available minute history through latest completed bar. Event windows are derived views; no need to duplicate the whole archive per event.

file_rules.plan.csv: One primary plan per event; no_trade plans have blank price fields.
file_rules.outcome.csv: One row per primary plan, including not_evaluated/unfilled/censored.
file_rules.levels.csv: Zero or more confirmed levels known at decision.
file_rules.ticks.csv: Optional; may include future ticks for labels, with phase separation; never read the whole file as model input.
